scope_note: Sinhala-medium delivery and support only. The English label is an internal/source gloss; Tamil-medium content and labels are deferred.
definition: Use number concepts and place value to read, represent, compare, and decompose whole numbers.
observable_success: Identifies the value represented by a digit in a four-digit number.
distinguishing_evidence: Repeatedly reports a digit's face value instead of its positional value across comparable items.

scope_note: Sinhala-medium delivery and support only. The English label is an internal/source gloss; Tamil-medium content and labels are deferred.
definition: Solve age-appropriate whole-number addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division problems.
observable_success: Solves addition problems while preserving place alignment and regrouping.
Solves multiplication problems using an appropriate fact or strategy.
distinguishing_evidence: A repeated regrouping pattern across addition items distinguishes a systematic error from a single slip.
Responses across related multiplication facts are needed before assigning fact-family confusion.

scope_note: Sinhala-medium delivery and support only. The English label is an internal/source gloss; Tamil-medium content and labels are deferred.
definition: Recognize, represent, compare, and use simple fractions and decimals in Grade 5 tasks.
observable_success: Finds a unit fraction of a whole quantity using division and explains the relationship.
distinguishing_evidence: Comparable items vary the numerator, denominator, and whole to distinguish a rule error from arithmetic difficulty.

scope_note: The stable LAN-BIL node remains a broad legacy aggregate. Version 1 binds only reviewed English curriculum content delivered with Sinhala-medium instructions and support; its Tamil strand is deferred.
definition: Use basic English listening, sound, word, spelling, and grammar knowledge for the Sinhala-medium pilot; the Tamil strand of LAN-BIL is deferred.
observable_success: Identifies sounds in familiar English words.
Recognizes familiar English word meanings and basic word classes when sufficient evidence is available.
distinguishing_evidence: Multiple observations are required to distinguish missing vocabulary or spelling knowledge from guessing or visual-attention slips.
